name: La Dérape
summary: Camille Felton alias Julia, a karting enthusiast, decides to take the wheel after an accident that has turned her life upside down. She faces a lot of adversity on the track and has to find her bearings in her relationships with others.

previousepisode.name: La vie n'est pas qu'une course

name: Les Invisibles
summary: Quebec serial about the lives and jobs of people working at a talent agency.

name: Discussions avec mes parents
summary: It is with sincere intimacy, but by mixing fiction and reality, that François Morency invites us among his family. Every week, we will witness the visits that bring him to the family home in the Saint-Sacrement district of Quebec City and his colorful exchanges with his parents, brother, sister and those around them.

name: 5e rang
summary: Marie-Luce is the eldest of six sisters and the family farm's dedicated heir. Her universe is turned upside down when her husband dies. Guy is found half-eaten in the pigpen. Murder or accident?

name: Apocalypse, La Guerre des mondes : 1945-1991
summary: Summer 1945. An iron curtain comes down, separating the Communist Eastern bloc and the West, led by the Americans. And nuclear weapons leaves mankind under perpetual threat of a new Apocalypse.

name: El Dragón: Return of a Warrior
summary: Miguel Garza has spent the last 20 years in Japan, following the murder of his parents when he was a boy. Now, he must return to Mexico to assume his position as the rightful heir of their family's drug cartel.

name: Witches of Salem
summary: Witches of Salem chronologically unravels the rapid descent of a town into madness, capturing the day-to-day hysteria that unfolds and puts an affluent New England community under siege. From reports of possession by the devil, to mass arrests, sensational trials and public hangings, each hour-long episode is an in-depth account of the eight months of "satanic panic" that overtook an otherwise sleepy Massachusetts village.

name: NWA Powerrr
summary: A new weekly show from NWA Wrestling.

name: Epic Trails
summary: Epic Trails follows host Eric Hanson as he explores the people, places and adventures surrounding the world's top trails.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final Parte 2: Me arrepiento de todo el daño que hice

name: Une autre histoire
summary: At 53, Anémone learns that she suffers from early-onset Alzheimer's. The life she had chosen, to forget the first, is on the verge of being turned upside down ... Another story is the past which comes to haunt the present, which imposes itself and which will dilute, crumble and quietly disappear.

name: Like-moi!
summary:
Like me! is a sketch comedy that illustrates the frenetic and hilarious quest for love and happiness.

It's not easy to live under the influence of the Web, blogs and social networks while looking for a soul mate!

name: Handmade in Bolton
summary: Shaun Greenhalgh and Dr Janina Ramirez research and remake a selection of precious objects from the past using traditional materials and methods.

name: Young, Dumb and Taking Drugs for Fun
summary: Four casual cocaine users talk frankly about their drug use, and learn about the impact of their recreational narcotic of choice on their bodies and society.

name: The Sacketts
summary: The Sacketts is a riveting Western saga that follows the journey of three brothers attempting to find their place in the world. Based on the books by Louis L'Amour, this made-for-television movie stars Tom Selleck, Sam Elliott and Jeff Osterhage as the Sackett Brothers, who head out West after the Civil War, embarking on a grand series of adventures. Glenn Ford, Ben Johnson and Jack Elam co-star in this grand Western.

name: Guilt
summary: When brothers Max and Jake unwittingly run over and kill an old man, their attempts to cover it up trigger consequences neither of them could ever have imagined.

name: Semi-Detached
summary: Each episode of Semi-Detached plays out in real time and follows a perennial loser called Stuart as his life goes down the pan in a suburban cul-de-sac. All Stuart wants is a quiet life as a wedding DJ but his family seems to have other ideas. On top of barely coping with a (much younger) partner April and a new born baby, Stuart also has to look out for his jailbird brother Charlie and his promiscuous, drug-taking Dad Willie. Then there's the ex-wife Kate, who lives across the cul-de-sac with their teenage daughter Madonna and Kate's husband Ted who thinks he's better than Stuart because he sells fish to sushi restaurants.

name: A Gift to the People You Hate
summary: The shop of a certain person wearing a mask sells gifts for people that you hate. There are four levels of gifts; making the receiver ashamed, scaring the receiver, hurting the receiver, and making the receiver die. Do you hate someone so much to give them this gift? Your hatred is their responsibility.

name: 7 Days of Romance
summary: Da Eun works part-time and Kim Byul is an idol in her 5th years since debut. These two girls who look alike decide to change each other's lives just for 7 days. It tells the romantic encounters of these 2 girls.

name: Evil's Wave
summary:
In 2014, a serial murderer preys only on women in Kawasaki. The victims' are hanged to death by their necks. The criminal investigation is difficult due to the lack of clues, but Detective Iguchi finds a man named Naoya Nogi.

It turns out Naoya Nogi's true identity is that of Masato Yaginuma. He was the victim in a case where a mother and son were kidnapped. What is Naoya Nogi's motive for the murders?

name: Brigada Costa del Sol
summary: A team of intrepid and impulsive police officers is formed to combat the birth of drug trafficking in 1970s coastal Spain.

name: Catching Britain's Killers: The Crimes That Changed Us
summary: The stories of murder investigations and their extraordinary consequences, which overturned laws, transformed police interrogation and revolutionised forensic detection.

name: Щас спою
summary: A unique musical show in which the "worst vocalists of the country" will gather on one stage to fulfill their cherished dream - to surpass themselves and sing as well as ever before. In each issue of "I'll sing right now" five "vocalists" will fight.

name: Amy Prentiss
summary: Amy Prentiss, a relatively young investigator becomes the first female Chief of Detectives for the San Francisco Police Department following the previous chief's death.

name: Phantasy Star Online 2: Episode Oracle
summary: With the advent of Photon technology, the spacefaring Oracle fleet searches for new planets to explore. They combat the Falspawn, abominations that consume all life in their path, with the fearless heroes of the ARKS organization. When his graduation ceremony is crashed by a Falspawn attack, young Cadet Ash realizes that he's just been thrust in the middle of a universal-scale conflict.

previousepisode.name: Quest 25: The Reason for Your Birth

name: Sandylands
summary: The series follows twenty-seven-year-old Emily Verma as she begrudgingly returns to her seaside hometown of Sandylands, following the news that her semi-estranged father Les Vegas is 'lost at sea' after a bloodied pedalo is found on the shore. Charged with putting his affairs in order, Emily quickly becomes a key person of interest for a mysterious one-eyed man, who's recently arrived in Sandylands and works for the life insurance company that's due to pay out over Les' unfortunate demise.

name: Feast Mansion
summary: Joji and Rich Brian are celebrating 88rising's Head in the Clouds album and getting ready for their upcoming tour by partying in the Hollywood Hills. There's only one problem: Who's going to bring all the food? In Feast Mansion, Brian and Joji are determined to feed their friends by any means necessary.

previousepisode.name: Smokepurpp, Joji, and Rich Brian Eat Hot Pot with Melo and Dumbfoundead

name: Dreamworks Spooky Stories
summary: Collection of Halloween horror comedy television specials, based on popular animated films.

previousepisode.name: Monsters vs. Aliens: Night of the Living Carrots

name: Feast Greece
summary: Feast Greece is a nine-part journey into an ancient land with a gloriously rich past. With its dramatic mountains, magical islands and deep blue seas, Greece is a country which seduces its travellers back time after time. Following the success of "Feast India" & "Feast Bazaar", Chef Barry Véra embarks on the journey of a lifetime, experiencing first-hand the culture, traditions, cuisine, and people of Greece.

name: Feast India
summary: Feast India is a lush, colourful and fascinating glimpse into Indian culture, food and customs, presented by English-born chef Barry Vera. Barry savours the surprising delights of simple street food and an amazing variety of tantalising regional cuisine, and immerses himself in the diverse cultural influences that make each area of India so distinct. From a Sikh temple kitchen in Delhi, where up to 70,000 meals are served each day, to life in a tribal desert village in Rajasthan; from vibrant markets and spice bazaars to a traditional village wedding; a heady cardamom auction to the chaotic buzz of Mumbai's beach carnivals and the eerie silence of a salt mine, and of course, much, much, more.

name: Feast Bazaar
summary: Heralding from the United Kingdom, chef Barry Vera worked in some of London's top restaurants before moving to Australia in 2001. In this global food adventure, he travels through Morocco and Syria on a mission to learn more about the culture and cuisine of these parts. Barry captures the flavours of Marrakech with his apple and fig bastilla, offers his take on the popular street snack spinach and feta fatayer and reminisces about summer holidays in the Mediterranean with grilled sardines.

name: Then & Now
summary: Series exploring the history of some well-known places.

name: My Horror Story
summary: Ordinary people share their chilling true tales of surviving the unknown. From hellish possessions and blood-drawing spirits to alien abductions and otherworldly creatures, these brave storytellers are shaken to the core as they recall their grave encounters with dark paranormal forces. It's a wild, horror-filled ride through the supernatural.

name: Полярный
summary: The bandit Vitya Myasnik, known in the mid-90s, who retired long ago and owns an eco-farm, at the request of a former accomplice, agreed to overstay the thieves' community on his offshore bank account. When it came time to return the money, by the will of circumstances, Vitya forgot the password from the account. Realizing that no one will believe him, he runs and accidentally ends up in the city of Polyarny located in the North.

name: The Imagineering Story
summary: Behind the magic of every Disney theme park lay mud, sweat, and fears. Creating happiness is hard work. For nearly seventy years, a unique blend of artists and engineers have cultivated an impossible notion from the mind of one man, Walt Disney, into a global phenomenon that touches the hearts of millions. These designers are called – Imagineers. Given unprecedented access, Academy-Award nominated filmmaker, Leslie Iwerks, leads the viewer on a journey behind the curtains of Walt Disney Imagineering, the little-known design and development center of The Walt Disney Company, to discover what it takes to create, design and build twelve Disney theme parks around the world.

name: Pixar in Real Life
summary: Pixar in Real Life brings iconic characters and moments from Pixar films into the real world. Filmed on location in and around New York City, the series surprises and delights real people in public places when they least expect it.

name: Fuzoroi no Ringotachi
summary:
Nakategawa, Iwata, and Nishidera are students at a low-level university, who set up a hiking club in order to meet girls. Their first catches comprise Harue and Yoko, who are studying to be nurses, and the plain Ayako who attends an elite women's college. Nakategawa also gets to know a club hostess Natsue, who is living with the misanthropic Honda, a Tokyo University graduate who runs a com-puter business from home.

As a coda to Japan's many educational dramas, Fuzoroi no Ringotachi features a new perspective on the importance attached to academic honors. Its characters chiefly lack any self-confidence and vision for the future but still make it through, regardless of their apparent failure to do well in the examination culture that so often defines "success".

name: Hotel Stars
summary: Every year, LP Paradise Hotel will accept only 10 internships from universities throughout the country in the "Hotel Stars" project, and 2 out of 10 will have the opportunity to receive outstanding internships. They will be placed as hotel staff immediately after the internship is complete and will be given a salary. High service charges and outstanding students will also have a chance to study hotel trips abroad. This year, the selected students, Akarotonpong, Kinteeyanuk, Ying K and Valen, all ten will be divided into groups. To switch internships in three missions, namely kitchen work, housewife work, and reception work. Including a special mission as well. Can all ten interns pass the Arahan checkpoint like the management team and supervisors to become an excellent intern? How about the relationship that Erung Tung Nang between them will be a hindrance to this competition?

name: Love Actually
summary: Do opposites really attract? An Qing Huan is a career woman who is highly driven to succeed. She is focused on her career and works very hard to work toward her goals in life. Ding Ren Jian is an IT engineer who doesn't think much past what he needs to do on a daily basis. He lives in the moment and tries to deal with what life throws at him. When Qing Huan meets Ren Jian, the two can't seem more different from each other. But as they both deal with their bustling lives, will they realize that they have more in common than they thought?

name: Never Say Never
summary:
A young man goes to great lengths to enter the drug syndicate to finish the undercover mission that his girlfriend started. 

Fang Han and his girlfriend were childhood friends. She was an exceptional cop and undercover. Upon finding out that she was killed, Fang Han is overwhelmed with grief. He receives a secret code that only he can understand and accepts a mission to infiltrate the drug ring himself. 

Acting impulsively and always putting himself on the line of fire gets him noticed by their target Gu Tao who begins to trust him. As they encounter countless dangers, Fang Han inches closer to finding his girlfriend's killer and to bringing down the syndicate once and for all.

name: Top League
summary:
Naoki Matsuoka is a reporter at the business desk for the Yamato Newspaper. One day he is transferred to the political desk. During a regular press conference held by Chief Cabinet Secretary Kondo, Naoki Matsuoka asks the Chief Cabinet Secretary "What do you think about the safe found in the reclaimed land in Minato, Tokyo?" The question got Chief Cabinet Secretary Kondo's attention. Due to that, Naoki Matsuoka is placed in charge of coverage of the Chief Cabinet Secretary Kondo and he soon becomes part of the "top league," which refers to a small group of reporters who dig into the prime minister, Chief Cabinet Secretary and senior officers of the ruling party. 

Meanwhile, Yuji Sakai, who used to work with Naoki Matsuoka, works as a reporter at a weekly magazine. He chases after the truth behind the safe that was found in Minato. Around this time, a robbery takes place. The victim of the robbery is a person who Yuji Sakai covered for the found safe story. 

Now, Naoki Matsuoka and Yuji Sakai meet for the first time in 10 years. A government taboo is soon revealed.

name: Delusional Girl Momo
summary:
A story about an otaku programmer who transforms into a man oozing with charisma after meeting Momo.

Because of an accidental encounter, Max is forced to live with Momo under one roof. Because of her, he begins to change from someone who used to avoid human interaction to someone who is open and willing to try new things.

name: Tiwa Sorn Dao
summary: Tiwa is the heir of a millionaire. Chomdao is a pretty and clever girl. They meet each other on an island in the middle of the sea.

name: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex: Tachikomatic Days
summary: Tachikomatic Days is a series of comedic shorts attached to the end of every episode of Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex. The shorts feature the antics of the Tachikoma tanks of Section 9.

name: The Perfect Plan
summary: The series follows three roommates, who fall behind in bills and rent and get caught up in a dramatic tale that leaves them running from dangerous gang lords, angry landlords, and crooked cops. The only way out is to come up with "The Perfect Plan".

name: Nashville Squares
summary: Nashville Squares puts a country music twist on the classic game show "Hollywood Squares," by staying true to the beloved tic-tac-toe format and infusing it with some of the most influential and charismatic personalities in country music, pop culture, entertainment, sports, fashion, comedy and more.

name: Klassentreffen
summary: 17 ex-pupils meet again after 25 years at a class reunion in Hürth. Of course, the archetypes should not be missing: the former best in class, the genius, the brat, the bully. But they are all in their mid-40s now and may have changed more or less. What has become of your former dreams and goals?

name: Os Normais
summary: Rui and Vani, are a couple facing normal discussions, problems and situations such as infidelity and convivency problems, but they solve it with great humor.

name: Brace: The Series
summary: In the not so distant future, a violent chemical attack decimated the world's population and leaves those who survived without the ability to speak. As the remaining populace regains their voice, the government has their own agenda in mind for society.

name: The Feather and Father Gang
summary: Harry Danton and Toni "Feather" Danton are a father and daughter team in a series where lawyer Toni calls upon ex-con man Harry to help her with her most tricky cases.

name: Wait 'Til Next Year
summary: The Lincoln Park Railsplitters are the laughingstock of Michigan high school football. They've lost 43 games in a row--a five-year losing streak--and they're just 5 losses away from owning the worst losing streak in state history. But the football team is sick of being kicked around. The cheerleaders are finished being taunted. This year everything is going to change. The kids from Lincoln Park are on a mission to do what nobody thinks they can: win. The series follows one season of football the team's players, cheerleaders, parents and fans embark on a journey to turn their lives around. From dating relationships to social struggles and family drama, they deal with the growing pains of high school while uniting first as friends, then as a team, and finally as a school hoping to start new legacy at Lincoln Park.

name: Behind the Glass
summary: The series is produced by NHL Network in association with NHL Original Productions, and it will not only showcase the over 50 players vying for 23 roster spots, it will also have plenty of content on notable veterans, including Taylor Hall (the reigning Hart Memorial Trophy winner as NHL MVP following a 39-goal, 54-assist season) and Brian Boyle (the reigning Bill Masterton Memorial Trophy winner for his inspiration comeback from leukemia). And the Devils are making a preseason/start of the season trip to Europe, which will see center Nico Hischier (the first overall NHL draft pick in 2017) return to his native Switzerland for an exhibition game against SC Bern and forwards Jesper Bratt and Marcus Johansson return to their native Sweden for the Devils' Oct. 6 regular-season opener against the Edmonton Oilers. The cameras will be there to cover all of that.

name: Craftopia
summary: On Craftopia, 9 to 15-year old contestants put their imaginations to the test and make their crafting dreams come true in a magical studio. After racing to fill up their carts with inspiring materials from the studio "store," crafters meet larger-than-life challenges, making the most amazing creations the world has ever seen.

name: Sophie Elise tester Norge
summary: Sophie Elise has built a career by sharing almost everything about herself. Now she wants to find out how other people live and think in Norway.

name: Karma
summary: Karma takes sixteen contestants, ranging in age from 12 to 15, completely off the grid, away from parents and the normal comforts of home, to solve puzzles and overcome physical challenges, with the laws of karma setting the rules. This adventure competition series, led by YouTube host Michelle Khare, will test the mental and physical stamina of its young contestants as they unravel how their social actions impact their success in the game. Focus, giving, humility, growth, connection, change, and patience are the path to becoming the "Karma Champion." But more importantly, the players learn one of life's most profound lessons: "What you give out, you get back."

name: Katla
summary: One year after the violent eruption of the subglacial volcano Katla, the peace and tranquility in the small town of Vik is dramatically disturbed. As people evacuate the area, the ice near the volcano starts to melt. The few remaining people manage to provide necessary community service. But despite its grand location, the area turns out to be somewhat apocalyptic — mysterious elements that have been deeply frozen into the glacier from prehistoric times start to emerge from the melting ice and cause consequences no one could have ever foreseen.

name: Retro Report on PBS
summary: Retro Report on PBS is produced by the award-winning team of journalists at Retro Report, who are dedicated to uncovering how news of the past continues to resonate today. Each episode ends with the signature wit of New Yorker magazine humorist Andy Borowitz.

name: White House Farm
summary: White House Farm is a factual drama that tells the story of when members of the same family were murdered at an Essex farmhouse.

name: Deadly Engineering
summary: Engineering failures are Icarus-like moments when our overreaching, greed and desire to conquer the impossible can cost not just reputations, but millions of dollars, the environment and lives. Each episode will focus on one disaster, looking at dramatic archive news footage of the disaster occurring and its devastating impact.

name: Emma: Queen of the South Seas
summary: Emma: Queen of the South Seas is a 1988 mini series based on the life of Emma Forsayth.

name: My Girlfriend
summary: When Ding Xiao Rou turned 17, a misunderstanding results in Xiao Rou believing that she will never find happiness. Yet she crosses paths with Chi Xin, thus starting a quirky romance.

name: Sweet and Sour
summary: A young band, The Takeaways, try to succeed in the music business.

name: La Minute Nécessaire de Monsieur Cyclopède
summary: "We can laugh at everything, but not with everyone" said Pierre Desproges at the time of the Tribunal des flagrants delirious. By creating for television The Necessary Minute of Monsieur Cyclopède, in 1982, because he does nothing between 8:33 p.m. and 8:35 p.m., he proves the opposite to the whole of France. Every night he divides the country into indignant fools and happy fools. History, doctors, democracy, science, death, racism, in one minute, he goes through various provocative subjects, with logical demonstrations but always based on the absurd. We find there his inimitable verve, his good words, his cynicism, but above all a devastating humor.

name: Lenny Henry's Race Through Comedy
summary:
Lenny Henry's Race Through Comedy concentrates primarily on British comedy of colour over the last five decades. Each film focuses on a particular area of comedy; sitcom, stand-up and sketch comedy.

Through the series there are contributions from a whole host of comedy greats including Meera Syal, Paul Whitehouse, Gina Yashere, Stephen K Amos, Javone Prince and Richard Curtis.

name: Aux Animaux La Guerre
summary: The intersecting stories of Martel, a union worker who takes on a dubious job to get himself out of a hole, Bruce, a bodybuilder on steroids, and Rita, a conscientious works inspector.

name: Jan Thomas og Einar blir venner
summary: We get to follow when the two quite different people Jan Thomas and Einar Tørnquist become friends, for real!

name: The Swiss Family Robinson
summary: Follows the adventures of a Swiss family shipwrecked on a deserted tropical island in 1801. It is loosely based on the classic novel by Johann Wyss.

name: Mental
summary: Welcome to the Primevères child psychiatry clinic. Marvin, a 17 years old teenager who is more accustomed to custody than medical exams, is interned after a court decision. He doesn't understands why he is here and makes it clear to the other residents and to the doctors. However, with Mélodie, Simon and Estelle, who have been in therapy for several weeks, they are going to shake up the daily life of the clinic while trying to find their own balance. Between recoveries and relapses, it is this new friendship that heals better than any pill.

name: Älska mig
summary: Friendship, grief and romance intersect with love in the lives of three generations of people living in Stockholm.

name: Field Trip with Curtis Stone
summary: In Field Trip with Curtis Stone, chef Curtis Stone embarks on a global culinary journey to explore the spirit and passion of the destinations which inform the menu at Maude, his Michelin-starred restaurant in Beverly Hills. Curtis and friends travel to Australia, Italy, Spain and California, hunting pheasants, herding cattle and diving for pearls as they track the delicacies Curtis serves in his restaurant to their source.

name: Psychopath Diary
summary: Psychopath Diary is about a man named Yook Dong Shik, who coincidentally witnesses a murder and loses his memory after an accident that occurs while fleeing the scene. He wakes up with no sense of identity and mistakes himself as the killer when he finds the murderer's diary in his hands.

name: The Andros Targets
summary: This action-drama set in New York revolves around Mike Andros, an investigative reporter working to expose corruption and injustice, without the aid of a gun or badge, for The Forum, a large metropolitan daily.

name: The Eyas
summary:
Aspiring musical genius accidentally enrolls in an air force recruitment program that launches him on a whole new path through life and across the skies.

Cheng Shu Yang is a promising pilot on paper, but nevertheless dismisses the chance he's offered to train until witnessing Kong Xin avert disaster on his return flight from the academy. After committing to re-enroll, Cheng begins to tackle the long road toward a career above the clouds, navigating the turbulence of this new itinerary from summer drills to coursework and beyond.

name: Diplomatic Situation
summary:
The story, starting from the birth of China 1949, mainly describes the contribution of the older generation of proletarian revolutionaries like Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Deng Xiaoping to China's diplomatic career.

With their ultra diplomatic strategic thought, flexible diplomatic skills, unique diplomatic style, extraordinary talent, they have won great honor and noble international status for the new-born China. This series comprehensively displays the Geneva Conference, Bandung Conference, Zhou En Lai's visit to Africa, China's restoration of the seat in the United Nations, as well as a series of magnificent diplomatic facts, showing the difficult and tortuous diplomatic process of the new-born China last century.

name: Aynen Aynen
summary: The series tells the story of Emir and Nil's entertaining relationship by explaining the relationship between men and women in a humorous as well as realistic language. We see the situations in which Nil and Emir want to show themselves to the other party in the relationship and in fact their own real thoughts.

previousepisode.name: Présenté par Patrick Bosso Invités: Eric et Ramzy

name: Lookism
summary:
The ugliest guy in school undergoes a miraculous transformation overnight that allows him to possess two different bodies, thus giving him a chance to start a new life.

After being constantly bullied and ridiculed in his old school, Wen Shuai finally gets the courage to transfer. One night, he comes into the possession of two bodies: one is his original body and the other has the visuals of everyone's ideal guy. Wen Shuai learns that his consciousness can easily travel between the two bodies; when one is awake, the other will remain unconscious. As he begins to enjoy new privileges as another person, Wen Shuai discovers that there is a hidden secret behind his handsome facade.

name: Analog Trip
summary: The two biggest K-pop acts--TVXQ! and SUPER JUNIOR--get a rare break with a vacation to Indonesia, only to discover that their luggage has been swapped with a time capsule from 2002.

name: Les Aventures de la courte échelle
Lacrimi de iubire
summary: The Varlams are among the richest families in Romania, Grigore Varlam, the head of the family, is a business man who has created an empire.

name: L'Accident
summary: In the peaceful Brittany town of Sainte-Lune, the body of Rebecca Cauvy is found in her car on a busy highway: drunk, parked in the wrong direction, she was hit hard by another vehicle. Gabriel, her husband, refuses to accept that this was a suicide or an accident. Anxious to restore Rebecca's honour and protect their young daughter, he leads the investigation, gradually revealing the results of a small community hit by recession. Is this "accident" just the tip of a terrifying iceberg?

name: Dans un grand vent de fleurs
Commissaire Valence
summary: Police captain Valence, an insomniac since the death of his wife in a car accident. heads a night squad which covers a Right Bank sector of Paris. Methodical and rigorous, he takes personal risks in order to avoid violence. When a well-known lawyer is found murdered in a hotel room, Valence investigates. In the early hours of the morning, he hunts the truth into the darkest reaches of urban delinquency and organized crime.

name: Oum le dauphin blanc
summary: The series presents the adventures of Zoom, a white dolphin, and his friends, two children who live with their sailor uncle. The cast includes several animals including a mynah bird (who understands the dolphin language in addition to the language of the other animals and the humans on the island and acts as a translator), a koala, and a sloth. During their adventures, Zoom meets a beautiful female dolphin, called Za-za-zoom in the English version, with whom he has a baby.

name: Innocente
summary: Marseilles. Roxanne Delage is a professor of archeology. She is married to Alexis, they have an 8 year old daughter, Alma. One afternoon, she goes to a private individual to assess a Mayan mask. She wakes up several hours later, half-naked next to a man's corpse. She panics and runs away. The police come to arrest her shortly after at her home, in front of her family, accused of having killed her lover. Charged, imprisoned, tried and sentenced to 12 years in prison, she decides to cut ties with those she loves to spare them the painful hours of visiting rooms. 8 years later, Roxane leaves prison and she is determined to prove her innocence. She will meet Hugo, the cop who had arrested him while he was ill, and gradually convince him that the real culprit is still in nature ...

name: Greco
summary: Series about a police officer who can see ghosts after he got wounded in the head. He helps them by solving their murders.

name: Aux frontières du possible
summary: This series depicts two agents from the "International Bureau of scientific prevention" (BIPS, "Bureau international de prévention scientifique") who are responsible for protecting mankind from the criminal use of the latest scientific discoveries.

name: Sleep Tight
summary: In the tradition of The Twilight Zone, each episode pulls you inside a new nightmare as Gen Z's favorite influencers fight to survive strange and supernatural horrors you can never unsee.

name: Smoking
summary: Seeking a greater justice, a band of homeless assassins flays their human targets and delivers the tattooed skins as proof of a contract fulfilled.

name: Van Loc : un grand flic de Marseille
Belphégor ou le Fantôme du Louvre
summary: A mysterious phantom appears in the Musée du Louvre in Paris at night. Neither the guards nor the police are able to arrest it. A curious young man tries to break the ice and discover what drives the creature and the background activities.

name: Rahan fils des âges farouches
summary: Rahan, after surviving a volcanic eruption, leaves the world in search of knowledge and adventure.

name: Private Lives of the Windsors
summary: Nearly 70 years ago, a new monarch ascended the British throne, Queen Elizabeth II. To succeed, she would need the full power and glamour of the Royal Family, but three key figures in her life would complicate that task: her rebellious sister, Princess Margaret, her husband Philip's power-hungry uncle, Lord Mountbatten, and the royal matriarch: the Queen Mother. Using letters and diaries written by the Windsors, we delve into the stresses and strains of their relationships as the Royal Family faces new challenges in the modern age.

name: Ahi Afuera
summary: They dreamed of a better world, but now they're living a nightmare. Neo-Western and love story in Patagonia.

name: Au théâtre ce soir
summary: Broadcasting recorded plays on television over two or three days, during public performances at the Marigny theater, on the Champs-Élysées, or sometimes at the Édouard-VII theater .

name: A Taste of History
summary: A Taste of History is a TV cooking series that explores America's culinary beginnings from the birthplace of American cuisine. This series brings America's history to life and makes it vibrant as we step back in time and get to know the founders of our country through the food they ate and the recipes they prepared.

previousepisode.name: Nourished by Nature | St. John's, Newfoundland

name: Gundam Build Divers Re:Rise
summary: Set two years after the story of Gundam Build Divers, a new version of the "Gunpla Battle Nexus Online" (GBN) game launches. The story centers on four Divers who participate with completely different play styles and levels. Hiroto is a lone Diver, Kazami is a Diver that plays in different parties, May is Diver who plays the game all day, and Parviz is a shy beginner with the determination to be in a party with other players. All four band together to form a team and experience something that goes beyond the game.

name: Flirty Dancing
summary: Flirty Dancing is part performance, part blind date, and all about romantic chemistry. In the show, complete strangers are each taught half of a dance routine, then meet for the first time on a blind date at a breathtaking location, where they will then dance together without saying a word. In this romantic approach to dating, these singles will push themselves out of their comfort zones in the hope of being swept off their feet, rather than swept to the left or right on a phone.

name: Dorohedoro
summary: Caiman is a person who has lost all of his memories after being transformed into a lizard-headed man by a sorcerer. Living in a grim urban region called Hole, he now hunts magic users in search of the one responsible for his metamorphosis in an attempt to recover his past and his face. Extremely strong and immune to magic, he has the help of his best friend, Nikaido. She is an agile fighter who runs a small restaurant at Hole. Their continuous slaughter of magicians calls the attention of a powerful sorcerer named En. He has his two best hitman, Shin and Noi, target the lizard-man and his ally. As Caiman delves deep into the search for his former identity, he starts acquiring odd clues that lead him into the bizarre magic world.

previousepisode.name: Ballad of the Happy Destruction / Question & Answer

name: Haterne
summary: Six Norwegian celebrities meet the trolls who hate them on social media face to face.

name: Ninth House
summary: Ninth House is set at an alternate Yale, where the secret societies guard dangerous, magical secrets and ghosts haunt the campus.

name: Corrector Yui
summary: Yui is an average schoolgirl who lives in a future where all computers are supported by a single global network known as COMNET. Yui is a computer-illiterate girl who after a computer-lab accident is approached by IR, a raccoon looking corrector computer program, which tells her she must save COMNET. She must stop the rogue A.I. (Artificial Intelligence) computer program known as Grosser and his hench-programs from taking over the world. Grosser was originally designed to be that manager of all of COMNET. At first she's very reluctant to play the heroine because of her complete lack of knowledge and ability with computers. To save COMNET she must find and gain the trust of the other seven wayward corrector programs. They must also find the creator or COMNET Professor Inukai, to help stop Grosser for good.

name: Masters of the Air
summary: Masters of the Air follows the men of the 100th Bomb Group (the "Bloody Hundredth") as they conduct perilous bombing raids over Nazi Germany and grapple with the frigid conditions, lack of oxygen and sheer terror of combat conducted at 25,000 feet in the air. Portraying the psychological and emotional price paid by these young men as they helped destroy the horror of Hitler's Third Reich, is at the heart of Masters of the Air. Some were shot down and captured; some were wounded or killed. And some were lucky enough to make it home. Regardless of individual fate, a toll was exacted on them all.

name: Sugar and Spice
summary: Loretta Fontaine and Vickilyn Fontaine Clayton, two black sisters living in a small Oklahoma town who attempt to raise their rambunctious teenage niece, Toby Reed (played by La Verne Anderson) after her parents are killed in a car accident. Vicklyn runs a curio shop called Small World Miniatures, and Loretta is a hostess at Cafe Jacques. All three live at 731 Oakwood Avenue in Ponca City.

name: One Night Steal
summary: Je is a girl that has luck all the time, while Not has bad luck. One night these two, came across each other and their luck reverses. Je is unhappy about this settlement, so she's planning to get her luck back.

name: Walker
summary: Walker centers on Cordell Walker, a widower and father of two with his own moral code, who returns home to Austin after being undercover for two years, only to discover there's harder work to be done at home. He attempts to reconnect with his children, navigate clashes with his conservative family, and find unexpected common ground with his new partner (one of the first women in Texas Rangers' history), while growing increasingly suspicious about the circumstances surrounding his wife's death.

name: Disney Fam Jam
summary: Each episode of Disney Fam Jam featuring two families hitting the floor in three unique rounds of dance battles to see which family will be crowned Disney Fam Jam Champs.

name: Unexplained and Unexplored
summary: Did the Maya Empire relocate to America? How did Meriwether Lewis really die? Where did the Ark of the Covenant end up after being smuggled out of Jerusalem? Explorers Justin Fornal and Emiliano Ruprah use historical maps as well as modern imaging techniques to examine these and other mysteries.

name: Shin Chuuka Ichiban!
summary: After passing the Guangzhou Special Chef Trials, Mao decided to travel around China, to learn more about the unique preparation of food. Upon his return, he will learn that the real battle has only just begun. The Underground Cooking Society has already begun to move...

name: LEGO Friends: Girls on a Mission
summary: Meet Andrea, Mia, Emma, Olivia and Stephanie. They're five best friends. And they're on a heroic mission: to save Heartlake City from wily swindlers.

name: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner
summary: David Chang is accompanied by a different celebrity guest exploring a single city, its culture and its cuisine. As the pair travels through each city, they will also uncover new and surprising things about themselves.

name: Rugal
summary: Rugal is about an elite detective who attempts to bring down a nationwide criminal organization named Argos. In the process, he ends up being targeted by the powerful criminals behind Argos, and not only does he lose his beloved wife and both of his eyes, but he is also framed for murder. After receiving a set of artificial eyes with special abilities created using biotechnology developed by an organization named Rugal, he sets out on a quest to wipe out the criminal organization responsible for his suffering.

name: America the Beautiful: Wild Frontier
summary: America the Beautiful tells the story of the frontier and wildlife closest to America's heart. We explore the woods that Davy Crocket once called home in the Great Valley of Appalachia, and where Wild Bill Hickok saw his last sunset in the Badlands of South Dakota.

name: Little Giants
summary: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators--lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author and expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

name: Pariu cu viața
summary: Pariu cu viața centers upon the love story between two teenagers Ioana Popa and Andrei Anghel whose destinies are switched at birth. Ioana and Andrei are students in their senior year at the National College of Arts. They are happily in love or at least this is what Ioana thinks until the moment she learns shes nothing but a bet Andrei made with Cristi, his best friend. What nobody knows is that Andrei has truly fallen for her. Disappointed, Ioana takes refuge in music, especially in LaLa Band, the modern music club created by the new music teacher at the college, Raluca. The 20 talented members of LaLa Band promise to insert new adrenaline into the post-Beatles music. They all have a great passion for music and big dreams to become international stars and have sold out concerts. Ioana was raised in a poor family by Gica Popa and Tantica together with her brother, Rafael and her sister, Gio. With plenty of humor and always looking for fun, the Popas live by the motto education is not important, only money matters. Andrei is a charismatic young guy who comes from a wealthy family that seems to be perfect. But the truth starts to come up when Anca, Andreis sister, is diagnosed with a severe kidney disease, inherited from Mara Anghels family. Her only chance of survival is a kidney transplant. After running the blood tests, Mara and Sandu Anghel have to face another shocking truth: Andrei is revealed as not being related to Anca or the family at all. Mara and Sandu Anghel realize their child was switched at birth in the tragic fire that occurred at the maternity hospital 17 years ago. And they begin the search of their real child the child that could save Anca's life as well as their own.

name: O nouă viață
summary: O nouă viață is a sequel to the 2011 TV series Pariu cu viața and it's the first Romanian musical soap opera.

name: Tanti Florica
summary: Florin Calinescu plays a loving mother, a widow, who, although she learns to love everything that moves in the lives of those around her, she loves above all her children, and the family is the most important thing in the world.

name: Ingeri Pierduti
summary: Ana Mateescu knows that the fairy tale time has passed. A learned person over the last few years to face the responsibility of the lured staff in front of the adults is crying. She can barely remember the good times in care she has a happy family, a house of her own and she lived with her parents, grandmother and sister without anyone to worry about tomorrow. After the death of her father, a grandmother and mother's departure to Spain, other changes followed in Ana's life. A house lost in the nursing home, being needed to move with Simona, her younger sister, in their aunt's apartment, Nuta.

name: Iubire ca in filme
summary: Ioana, a 23-year-old girl is suffering terribly after the death of her parents. She takes care of her sister, Raluca, making money from a bar, hiding this from her sister, lying to her that he is a psychologist. The situation becomes more difficult when Raluca falls in love with Dragoș, and her best friend falls in love with the same man. Ioana knows Stefan he falls in love with. He wants to get rid of his possessive mother's influence, asking for help from Ioana, believing that she is a psychologist. The boy's mother wants to marry Adina, who is fighting with Ioana for the boy's love. Zuzu, the owner of the bar where Ioana works, joins Ioana for better and for worse, both she and the other girls.

name: Nimeni nu-i perfect
summary: The story centers around the Chivu and Predescu families. Unemployed and divorced Dan Chivu lives with his 17-year-old son, Oaki and his older brother, 40-year-old bachelor Valentin (Vali). Ambassador Predescu lives in a grand villa with his daughter Irina, 17-year-old granddaughter Simona and Anton Valet. Dan commits himself to the Predescu villa as a nurse! This is where the complications arise, because Dan has taken on a new identity, Mrs. Dana. Predescu does not support it and puts the nickname "Monkey with earrings". Oaki likes Simona, but she does not dare to reveal her feelings. Simona is together with Robert (the school basketball player) who is also wanted by Mădălina (Mădă), Simona's best friend. In the second season, things get complicated, because Dana is asked to marry Predescu and reveals her true identity. Predescu goes into a coma because of the shock, but he wakes up after a long time (in which Dan was worried that Predescu would never wake up again and that it might be his fault. sued him) with amnesia. Meanwhile, Oaki and Simona fall in love, but their love affair does not last long, due to a country girl, Maria, who falls in love with Oaki ... Simona desperately tries to give Robert's slippers to be his girlfriend to Oaki. It only succeeds when it is too late (Oaki and Maria being a couple), and Robert forms a relationship with Mădă. Also, Dan is forced to take on a third identity, the psychologist Tomescu, who makes daily meetings with the Predescu family. Other important characters would be Bobo, Oaki's childhood friend who despite his weight, always remembers that he would have friends and the director of the high school, nicknamed by children, Cruela. Bobo was the first to meet Maria (of course telling her friends about her as a girlfriend), having feelings for her. After failing with Maria, Bobo tries his luck with the most desirable girl in high school ... Simona. Cruel instead does not play much in the first season, it is only an obstacle in the execution of minor plans. In the second part, however, becoming Vali's girlfriend, she has a much bigger role. In the middle of the second season Eva appears, the lost and found daughter of Ambassador Predescu.

name: Numai Iubirea
summary: The first ever romanian TV show follows Dan Bratu and Bianca still dealing with Ioana Bratu's death, a beloved wife and mother.

name: Arestat la domiciliu
summary: Arestat la domiciliu presents the life of a typical Romanian family. The Dumitru family is so "normal" that after 15 years of marriage, the head of the family, Costica, is seriously thinking of fleeing the world. His wife, Nuti, is almost perfect, but in Costica's eyes he still has a small flaw: there is! Their two twins, Luca and Raluca, are diametrically opposed, they hate each other and stress their father with any trifle. And, as if two teenagers with problems were not enough in a house, a third child is on the way ... And Nuti's brother, Ion Bunescu, a religion teacher, recently married the woman of dreams his, Beatrice, a former "exotic dancer" that he brings more and more often to the house of the Dumitru family.

name: Mother's Garden
summary: A woman gets to live at her biological mother's boarding house with her stepmother after her father dies and his business goes down. This struggling family overcomes life challenges together through love and compassion to reach a happy ending.

name: O Săptămână Nebună
summary: Alex Puica, a young man that seems to be followed by trouble and bad luck, is soon to marry Maria, daughter of the respectable Emilian and Natalia Codrescu.

name: Take Me to Your Mother
summary: Take Me to Your Mother follows Andrea Rosen as she meets moms from different parts of society and with different backgrounds, learning about how to best raise her children.

name: America from Scratch
summary: America from Scratch showcases the best the internet has to offer, while celebrating the impact of public media.

name: Leavenworth
summary: Leavenworth is centered on Clint Lorance, who's serving a 19-year sentence for murder at The United States Penitentiary, Leavenworth. While deployed in Afghanistan in July 2012, the former lieutenant ordered fire on three local men riding a motorcycle, killing two of them and outraging his platoon. In a first-hand account of a soldier navigating the U.S. Army's legal system, Lorance seeks to overturn his conviction, provoking emotional debate between supporters and detractors that rises to the national stage. As determinations on Lorance's fate unfold, questions probe not only the merits of his conviction, but analyze the system at large and ultimately test the balance of guilt and innocence in the inscrutable circumstances of today's wars.

name: Best før
summary: Lena has reconciled herself with the old-age job, but life at home is becoming increasingly complicated. Lena and Morten's plan to maintain a normal and relatively harmonious relationship becomes difficult to implement because Anemone wants full control over Morten and Lena at a long distance. At the same time, Lena continues the pursuit of love!

name: XXX: Uncensored
summary: It's sexy. It's racy. It's India's hottest original show.

name: Love Again
summary: A story of graduates from a co-ed school reuniting after 30 years and facing reality reflected by their past.

name: Love and Ambition
summary:
Park Tae Joon is an intelligent law student and a filial son to his parents who runs a mill. His has a younger brother, Tae Soo not quite as academic still quite smart and a known brat in town, and a younger sister, the kind and gentle-hearted Sun Hee. From the same town as Tae Joon, Kim Mi Ja, his love interest is sick and tired of living in poverty and desires to leave their small town for a better life. One day after their father's death, the family learns that they will lose their home as a pledge due to an assurance their father has made before his death.

From the poverty stricken post war era of the 1950s to the modern times of Korea, this TV drama follows a family and the surrounding characters who rode the drastic changes with passion.

name: Love and Ambition
summary: Park Tae Joon is an intelligent law student and a filial son to his parents who run a mill. He has a younger brother, Tae Soo, who is not quite as academic, but still quite smart and a known brat in town, and a younger sister, the kind and gentle-hearted Sun Hee. Kim Mi Ja, Tae Joon's love interest, is from the same town and is sick and tired of living in poverty. She desires to leave their small town for a better life. One day after their father's death, the family learns that they will lose their home as a pledge due to an assurance their father has made before his death.

name: Love and Hate
summary: Jung Hee's husband affair had twisted his mistress's fate so tightly together with his wife, that even his death did not break the cruel bond between the two woman. Now years later, will history repeat itself once more when the women meet again? Can these two women break free of hate to love again?

After the breakdown of the old government, and with it the First Republic, Italy changed for good in 1994. Spinster Leo is all too aware of this. He pushed hard to see Berlusconi get elected Prime Minister. He knows it's not easy to win power, but holding on to it verges on the impossible. By the same token, it seems equally impossible for populist politician Pietro to change. Even now that he has an office at the Prime Minister's premises in Rome, he still can't cast off his old bad habits. Nor can he forget the only woman he has ever loved. A former TV starlet now turned politician and Congresswoman, Veronica has to decide who the man of her life is going to be. She has realized she no longer wants to be just a woman on the arm of powerful men. It is the start of her own push for power.

name: Glad You Asked
summary: Ever wonder what "the cloud" a.k.a. the internet actually looks like? Or why memes look the way they do? Our crew rides four-wheelers into a desert, meets with an orthopedic surgeon who was struck by lightning, and tracks down the world's leading experts to answer these questions and more.

name: The Adventures of Dudley the Dragon
summary: Dudley is a dragon who recently woke up from centuries of hibernation. He meets his new ten-year-old friends Matt and Sally as well as other kids down the line. The many kids guide Dudley around the modern world and the trio learn about environmentalism, friendship and pro-social values.

name: Detail: From the Mind of Kobe Bryant
summary: Determination wins games, but Detail wins championships...

name: Вернувшиеся
summary: Every year more than 120,000 people disappear without a trace in Russia. Someone went into the forest and got lost, someone left work, but never made it home. TV-3 project "Returned" will tell real stories about people who have been found, and about those who are still looking for...

name: The Fred Waring Show
summary: The Fred Waring Show includes performances by his orchestra and large chorus, as well as dancing and sketches.

name: Office Watch
summary: Office Watch is about what goes on in an office, showing the main characters struggling with a variety of very difficult coworkers but also captures blooming office romance.

name: Trial by Kyle
summary: The toughest cases, biggest celebrities and genuine disputes can only be settled by one man, radio shock jock Kyle Sandilands. Kyle will pass judgement across a whole range of real life cases. Helping him analyze the evidence once again will be former The Bachelor Australia star and criminal lawyer Anna Heinrich.

name: MIXTAPE
summary: MIXTAPE puts the spotlight on a different rock icon each week as they sit down to discuss their favorite songs and share their own personal "mixtape" of meaningful music that shaped their lives and careers. Filmed in the landmark Gibson Guitar Showroom in Hollywood, California, MIXTAPE gives viewers an exclusive interview with some of rock's most iconic figures where they tell the story of their lives through the songs that they love. MIXTAPE is also packed with surprise appearances and unplugged performances. MIXTAPE is the ultimate classic rock experience that music lovers of all ages will not want to miss.

name: Замок из песка
summary: How to survive if nothing is left? Is it possible to start life anew in a strange city where no one needs you? How to find the strength to go further and not let circumstances and your own fears break you? The life of Marina Romanova was like a fairy tale, which every woman dreams of - a loving husband, little son, a country house and a successful business. But in the yard the end of the 90s, and a difficult time makes its own adjustments. Marina's beautiful life disappears in one moment, just as an incoming wave washes away a wonderful sand castle ...

name: Dr. T, Lone Star Vet
summary: Dr. Lauren Thielen is back home in Texas to open her very own exotic animal practice, located alongside one of the state's largest and busiest animal hospitals. With the support of the 24/7 emergency room staff, and more than a dozen specialists, she treats everything from emus to hedgehogs, and whatever else comes through the door. Dr. Thielen will deliver dramatic and heartwarming stories of animals in need, all with her Texas-sized dose of charm we've all come to love. Join Dr. T on her journey to create her own legacy as she follows her dreams.

name: Prost Mortem – Die letzte Runde
summary: The second German in-house production of the pay TV station 13th Street is a classic, black-humored crime thriller in a modern guise.

name: La Dernière Vague
summary: In Brizan, a quiet seaside resort in the french Landes, everything changes with the arrival of the first wave which, like a tsunami, will cause the disappearance of surfers and disrupt the intimate life of the inhabitants.

name: 48 ore
summary:
The series tells the story of a group of police officers from the police station of Genoa, that belong to the Flying Squad, whose job it is to capture the fugitives.
48 hours represent the time limit beyond which a fugitive's tracks are likely to be lost. In order to operate in such a short amount of time agents are sourced with the most diverse skills as possible.

name: Lalabel
summary: Lalabel is a magical girl who arrives in the Human world to stop an evil wizard from stealing various magical objects or items. As a magical girl, she has a kitty for a companion and a magic wand. Coincidentally, she lands on the doorstep of the Tachibana couple and lives in with them during her stay in the human world. She attends the local school and begins to learn about the different things in the human world.

name: Run the World
summary: Run the World is the story of a group of Black, vibrant, fiercely loyal best friends who work, live and play in Harlem as they strive for world domination. At its core, it's an unapologetically female show about enviable friendship and not only surviving—but thriving together.

name: Ultramarins, ultraterriens
summary: Many Ultramarines leave their territories whether for their studies, the creation of a business, desires elsewhere, the impossibility of exercising their talents at home or by sexual orientation. If the reasons for their departure are indeed multiple, what are the triggering factors? How do these Ultramarines choose the host country, remoteness, integration and success when the overseas territories do not necessarily have the means to retain their children. Six Ultramarines have agreed to testify and tell their new life.

name: Exit 57
summary: Exit 57 is a sketch comedy show starring alumni from Second City: Stephen Colbert, Amy Sedaris, Paul Dinello, among others.

name: Another Me
summary: Two best friends' relationship is strained when they fall in love with the same man.

name: The Hustler
summary: Each episode of The Hustler follows five contestants as they collaborate to answer a series of trivia questions, with the goal of building a collective prize pot that increases with each correct answer. The catch? One of the five contestants, the Hustler, already knows the answers but must keep their identity a secret in order to have a shot at winning the grand prize. Throughout each episode, two contestants are anonymously eliminated by the Hustler, leaving three remaining contestants – the Hustler and two others, who must collectively decide who they think the Hustler is. If they are right, they share the prize pot. If the two contestants are wrong, the Hustler goes home with the full cash reward.

previousepisode.name: A Little of This, A Little of That

name: Stille Waters
summary: Stille Waters was a Flemish drama series commissioned by VRT-TV1. This 2001 co-production between TV1 (now: one; first network of the Flemish public broadcaster) and Fonds Film in Vlaanderen (now: VAF; Vlaams Audiovisueel Fonds) pushes the boundaries of television fiction by spreading a long haunting story over 13 episodes. The heroic battle between a powerful industrialist (Alex Vorlat) and a young woman (Jana Meyer) who goes in search of the cause of her father's death creates haunting drama along the banks of the Scheldt in the region of Klein-Brabant.

previousepisode.name: レッドのゆきがっせん！

name: Joseon X-Files: Mystery Investigation Record
summary: Joseon X-Files is based on cases detailed in the Annals of Joseon History with a bizarre twist; these incidents incorporate mysterious, supernatural elements that cannot be explained through science. Kim Hyung Do is an inspector of the state whose single-minded focus on his investigations into administrative misdeeds bring him into direct contact with these strange mysteries. Heo Yoon Yi is a government employee who aids him and attempts to understand these scientific impossibilities with an open mind, in contrast to his cynicism.

name: Dr. Blackson
summary: "The Therapist" has nothing on Dr. Blackson…as in the unfiltered and unbothered comedian, Michael Blackson. Have issues in the bedroom, with body image, or your sexual orientation? Come to Dr. Blackson and he will fix you like that. But is he kind, gentle, and caring? Hell, no. Get your mind right or else, modasucka! This series is the natural next step for Michael's hugely popular ‘advice column' on his Social Media pages, where random people write to Michael with their problems, then await his usually outrageous advice.

name: Banyon
summary: A period drama set in 1930s Los Angeles that follows the life of private investigator Miles C. Banyon, a tough-but-honest detective who would accept essentially any case for US$20/day.

name: Nakia
summary: Nakia follows full-blooded Navajo Nakia Parker, a deputy sheriff in the fictional town of Concord in fictional Davis County in 1974 New Mexico. Nakia balances ancient tribal customs and the use of modern police methods which occasionally leads to opposition from his more narrow-minded white neighbors--including his boss, Sheriff Jericho.

name: N.Y.P.D.
summary: N.Y.P.D. follows three New York police detectives as they solve a wide range of crimes and arrest criminals. The show features many real New York City locations, as well as episodes based on actual New York City police cases.

name: Could You Survive the Movies?
summary: Could You Survive the Movies? explores the science behind classic movies, breaking down scenes and images to explain what they would look like in the real world.

name: Finding Alice
summary: Finding Alice is a drama series about a woman who loses her husband in a freak accident only to find he has left her to unravel a trail of secrets, debt and criminality.

name: Ted Lasso
summary: Ted Lasso centers on an idealistic — and clueless — all-American football coach hired to manage an English football club — despite having no soccer coaching experience at all.

name: Himitsu no Akko-chan
summary: Atsuko "Akko-chan" Kagami (known variously as "Stilly," "Caroline," or "Julie" in Western versions of the anime) is an energetic elementary school girl who has an affinity for mirrors. One day, her favorite mirror which was given to Akko by her mother (or in some versions, by her father, as a present from India) is broken, and she prefers to bury it in her yard rather than throw it to the trash can. In her dreams, she is contacted by a spirit (or in some cases the Queen of the Mirror Kingdom) who is moved that the little girl would treat the mirror so respectfully and not simply throw it away. Akko-chan is then given the gift of a magical mirror and taught an enchantment that will allow her to transform into anything she wishes.

name: Distretto di polizia
summary: Life and work in a police station of Rome. The chief of the station, Giovanna Scalise, has arrived in town after a long period passed in the city of Palermo, Sicily, where she fought against mafia.

name: My Restaurant Rules
summary:
Heading the judging table are internationally renowned chefs and restaurateurs Colin Fassnidge (My Kitchen Rules) and Judith Tabron, tasting their way through the team's culinary delights in the hopes of discovering New Zealand's best hidden gem.

From traditional Italian fare in Nelson, paddock-to-plate-styled kai in Waiouru and delicious seafood in Christchurch, every restaurant offers something different - and this series will dish up mouth-watering food in restaurants that viewers can visit and try themselves.

The first round of the competition sees Colin, Judith and the teams visit each restaurant where they eat an entrée, main and dessert, before eliminating the team with the lowest score.

Round two begins with the four remaining teams being given $20,000 and 72 hours to renovate their restaurant's interior and menu before hosting again for the second time.

This time, they're not only hosting the judges and other teams, but also local restaurateurs and food critics.

After some advice from Colin, it will be time to see who's learnt the most and improved, with the bottom two teams being eliminated before the Grand Final.

The Grand Final takes place over consecutive nights, with the final two teams battling it out for the title and incredible cash prize.

With their restaurants open to the public and the pressure of cooking a three-course meal for a full house – which team will crumble, and which team will be told their restaurant rules?

name: Your Room or Mine?
summary: Four teams make over each other's homes to see who has the best taste in interior design.

name: MUNCHIES Guide to...
summary: No more bad meals, or at least you'll have less of them. MUNCHIES presents a series of guides to eating in some of the best, most exciting, or most underrated food destinations around the world.

name: Sounds of the Dolomites
summary: Legendary Italian cellist Mario Brunello prepares to play in the middle of the Dolomites in one of the highlights of the high-altitude summer festival in Trentino, Italy.

name: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies
summary: Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies is inspired by the 1978 Golden Globe® nominated film Grease. A joyous musical series set in and around the world of Rydell High, the show reimagines the global smash hit movie with some characters you already know, and a whole lot more you will soon meet. It's still the 1950s, a world that rocks with big musical numbers from the period combined with new original songs as well. It's the peer pressures of high school, the horrors of puberty, and the rollercoaster of life in middle America with a modern sensibility that will bring it to life for today's musical lovers.

name: 2gether The Series
summary: To evade an admirer, Tine plays up a relationship with a pretend boyfriend, Sarawat, until the act turns to reality.  Adapted from JittiRain's novel.

name: A Year in the Fast Lane
summary: A 6-part documentary following the Benetton Formula 1 team through the 1997 F1 World Championship season.

name: Squadra mobile
summary: When Roberto Ardenzi is promoted to police chief, he finds himself managing a new group of strong-willed policemen afflicted by personal problems, as well as trying to reconcile work with his private life, especially in the relationship with his twenty-year-old daughter Mauretta.

name: A Tale of Thousand Stars
summary: A volunteer teacher dies in a tragic accident, in which her heart is transplanted to Tian. Through a series of diary entries Tian learns about her life; her secrets and interests. Including her promise to military officer Phupha, about counting a thousand stars with him. Tian then decides to follow in her footsteps and complete her dream. With Tian a new volunteer teacher, he attempts to befriend Phupha. Yet, Phupha gives off a cold exterior. Slowly the two grow close, but Tian's heart beats fast around the military officer. As he starts to fall for him, much like its previous owner did. But with the area being war-ridden and dangerous, can they keep their thousand-star promise?

name: Unasked Family
summary: A housewife who has gone through a stormy marriage and a man with an upbeat personality who also weathered a tough times try to "reset" their lives.

name: The Demon Headmaster
summary: All is not what it appears at Lizzie's new school. There's something seriously spooky about the strange Headmaster and Lizzie is determined to find out what's going on, before it's too late.

name: Swanenburg
summary: When pater familias Jack Praal is confronted with his biggest fear and his youngest son is associated with a murder of a woman, the family will be taken into a web of intrigues and betrayal. A battle in which the family is trying their best to stay close to each other, but is almost impossible to hold on to.

name: World's Worst Flights
summary: Using jaw-dropping footage recorded by those on board, this series straps you in for a roller-coaster ride.

name: The Shipper
summary: A fujoshi who is a hard shipper had an accident and her soul got into Kim's body. She takes advantage of the situation to make her ship sails while Kim's brother notices that his brother is not the same.

name: Prince Charles: Inside the Duchy of Cornwall
summary: Prince Charles: Inside the Duchy of Cornwall is a series with privileged access to Prince Charles and his private domain, the Duchy of Cornwall, the ancient Royal estate which he has built up over the last 50 years into a billion pound business to support himself, his immediate family and his charities.

name: Chain Letters
summary: In Chain Letters, three contestants compete to win money by changing letters in words to form new words.

name: Колл-центр
summary: Twelve co-workers of the call center of the online shop "Boutique for Adults" are trapped on the 12th floor of the Gloria Plaza business center in Moscow. Suddenly the intruders named "mom" and "dad" tell them that the building is mined. For a bomb not to explode, the workers must comply with the criminals' demands. Will the hostages be able to defuse the bomb in 8 hours, escape and still remain humans?

name: Al Yazmalim
summary: A beautiful love story between two young adults. Is it going to be the love of his life or the dream of his life? based on the novel My Poplar in a Red Scarf by Chinghiz Aitmatov and the Turkish romantic drama film The Girl with the Red Scarf.

name: Cuisine Sauvage
summary: Jonathan Czodor Ichmoukametoff (known as John C.) finds himself in each episode in the company of a great chef cooking in the middle of nature in a French region. Each chef is only allowed to take with him three kitchen accessories and three ingredients of his choice. For three days, John C., specialist in Survival Techniques and founder of the school of life and survival in the forest as well as of the school of scouts-trackers, will introduce the chef to survival in the wilderness: hunting, fishing, gathering, cooking food, obtaining drinking water...

name: Gente di Mare
summary: A brilliant coastguard lieutenant, Angelo Sammarco returns to Tropea in Calabria, the city of his childhood, for a delicate investigation. He must elucidate the murder of a young woman of whom the commander in post whom he temporarily replaces is suspected. In his mission, he faces the reluctance of the team in place, but above all his memories. Orphan of mother, Angelo left Tropea at 16, after the disappearance of his father in unexplained circumstances. He reconnects with old relationships and falls in love with Margherita, a childhood friend...

name: Big Bounce, la course de trampoline
Relatively Evil
summary: Inspired by the box office smash, GET OUT each episode of this intimate psychological thriller will explore the terrifying, real-life events of an outsider who falls for someone in a seemingly normal family only to find themselves entangled in an evil clan capable of abuse, kidnapping, or something even more sinister.As each story unfolds, this fatal fish-out-of-water series is a reflection of life's own unpredictable path of twists and turns, in a journey that exposes the shady underbelly of the family tree. All the while the newcomer is questioning their own sense of reality and in some cases, morality as small signs of trouble become dark and deadly. Once you join the family, can you ever get out?

name: La smala s'en mêle
summary: Twenty-five years of marriage: it's time to celebrate! A couple as envied as they are united, three children, two of whom are adopted, Isabelle Garnier is more than ever delighted with this success, her success, that of a lifetime! A pithy note from her husband left on the pillow, bank accounts emptied, in less than 24 hours, and now the life, as peaceful as it is installed, of this housewife, charitable bourgeois, a blessed ass nothing, turns to the survival operation.

name: Victor Hugo, ennemi d'État
summary: 1848, Paris under Siege: Victor Hugo is torn between his family, his mistresses and political turmoil - never mind finally completing his classic novel Les Miserables. Although Hugo is a confirmed Royalist, he supports the Republic and Louis Napoléon Bonaparte, who is soon to become president, convinced that he will initiate social reforms. But when the new government is formed and Hugo is overlooked for office, he realizes that he has been used. Furious at the deception, he and his sons launch a daily newspaper to give the people a voice. Nor is it less chaotic on the home front, as he is juggling his love life between two mistresses and his long-suffering wife and mother of his children. When Napoléon seizes power and his sons are jailed for insurrection, Hugo insists that his wife and daughter leave Paris, where he remains, devoting himself wholeheartedly to the resistance. Openly denouncing repression, he is declared Enemy of the State and has to face disgrace and exile.

name: Sauveur Giordano
summary: In disagreement with his hierarchy, for incompatibility of spirit and method, Sauveur Giordano left his position as number two in the Minors Brigade. As a citizen reflex, he chose to work for the "Ultime defense" victim support association, run by Louise Ventura. There, he exercises his talents as a solo detective to save the poorest of whom he is the last resort. Giordano is a maverick whose activities come up against official police investigations. Conflict is then inevitable. Make justice triumph over injustice: if his motto is simple, his fight is complex and constantly repeated.

name: Anatane et les enfants d'Okura
summary: Paris, 2213. Like all boys approaching the age of 15, Anatane Goliatkine knows that he will soon be taken to Okura. Like his father before him, he will become a docile Buzi, a worker destined to work on the Great Project of Clunk, the dictator ruling the new world order since the end of the third Great War which ravaged the planet. However, during a simple snowball fight, Anatane's fate changes. Discovering an incredible power of invisibility, the boy then becomes the most wanted fugitive in the world... Representing a direct threat to the Clunk dictatorship, Anatane also reveals new hope for all the rebels and resistance fighters dispersed around the world. To put an end to the dictatorship, to free men from their Buzi condition, Anatane Goliatkine leaves Paris with his friends Nikita and Nevenaa, and his younger sister Ariane. Thus begins a long journey to the East, towards Okura.

name: 72 heures
summary: The Côte d'Azur, where the inhabitants are as beautiful as the landscape... But beneath the veneer of wealth and fame hides a world of greed and intrigue, even horrific criminal acts. All these recent murders, and the great disorder that accompanies them, leave no respite to the criminal brigade of the region. In particular to Laura and Vincent, two young police officers appointed to create an anti-criminal unit. They are very close, and care about each other as much as they do about their work. Laura is a lovely young woman. His passion for his work as a policeman is matched only by his love of the human race. Vincent is a sexy young man. His devotion leads him to clean up this too often corrupt "paradise". And, although he denies it, he is very attracted to Laura.

name: Great Lighthouses of Ireland
summary: Great Lighthouses of Ireland tells the story of Ireland's lighthouses and their continuing importance to the country's survival with spectacular scenes from Hook Head, Skelligs, Blacksod, Galley Head and Ballycotton with incredible stories from former lighthouse keepers.

name: Dash & Lily
summary: Dash & Lily revolves around cynical Dash and optimistic Lily who trade dares, dreams, and desires in the notebook they pass back and forth at locations all across New York City, finding they have more in common with each other than they would have expected.

name: I Don't Love You Yet
summary: Mitari Yo is a career woman who works for a shoe company. She finds her work rewarding and has successfully advanced in her career. Her love life, on the other hand, isn't doing as well. Ishida Ren works for a real estate developer and is Yo's best friend. An ex-classmate from both high school and university days, he understands her best and is the only person she pours her heart out to. On Yo's 29th birthday, the two friends place a wager to give 300,000 yen as a congratulatory gift to the one who is the first to get married by the last day they are both 30. Although they declare that it is impossible for them to fall in love with each other, this wager, as well as advances by Ren's junior in the company and Yo's reunion with her ex-boyfriend, lead to gradual changes in the relationship of the two best friends.

name: Checking In
summary:
In the seventh-season finale episode of The Jeffersons, "Florence's New Job", the Jeffersons' maid, Florence Johnston, accepted a job to become the executive housekeeper at the fictional St. Frederick Hotel in New York City. Checking In follows Florence's misadventures at the hotel with her co-workers: Lyle Block, her stuffy manager; Elena Beltran, her assistant; Earl Bellamy, the inept house detective; Hank Sabatino, the lewd handyman; Betty, the floor supervisor; Dennis, the bellboy; and Mr. Claymore, the hotel owner.

Faced with low ratings, the series was cancelled, with the final episode airing on April 30, 1981. Gibbs then returned to her regular role on The Jeffersons and it was explained that the St. Frederick Hotel had burned down.

name: Andy op Patrouille
summary: Most people know Andy Peelman as an actor, but did you know that he is also a real police officer? In Andy op Patrouille we will follow Andy when he is visiting his foreign colleagues.

name: Zombody Save Me!
summary: Who would survive a zombie apocalypse? 8 brave Kiwis are ready to test their survival skills - and fend off a ferocious horde of the living dead - in the wildest new local reality show of 2019!

name: Famille d'accueil
summary: Located on the outskirts of Bordeaux, the Ferrière house sees a lot of people pass through, and for good reason: Marion is a family assistant and is regularly entrusted with children of all ages cared for by social services. With her husband Daniel and their own offspring, she tries to help them, whatever the problems they encounter, while having to manage her own family life, in which there is no shortage of adventures. Through the foster children, various social facts are addressed in this fiction full of good feelings.

name: Quart de vie
summary: A crazy comedy inspired by the sitcom, Quarter Life follows the adventures of three friends who struggle to find their place in a world where, in their twenties, there are three ways to fulfill themselves: by starting a family, by creating Facebook or by participating in Occupation Double. Thus, when her boyfriend announces to her in surprise that he has bought a house so that they can start a family, Ariane, mid-twenties, decides to flee. Lost, homeless and penniless, she meets Constance and Bam, two unbalanced but well-meaning roommates who take her under their wing. Together, the three friends will discover through fiascos that there is only one way to get out of the quarter-life crisis alive: it is by being surrounded by friends who are as disoriented as you are.
